name: TomOpt Two-Stage Differentiable Optimization
definition: A differentiable optimization pipeline that updates detector panel positions and budget assignments by minimizing a task-specific loss function using automatic differentiation, ensuring changes directly impact final task performance rather than proxy metrics.
summary: TomOpt is a differentiable optimization pipeline that updates detector positions and budget assignments by minimizing task-specific loss, distinguished by its two-stage annealing strategy that decouples transverse and longitudinal optimization phases.
